_comment: Copy this file to aws_config.json and fill in real values. device_id must match the AWS IoT 'thing' name and the CN on cert_path. Certs come from AWS IoT Core > Manage > Things > Create thing (or 'aws iot create-keys-and-certificate'); AmazonRootCA1.pem is downloaded from AWS's published root CA list, not generated per-device.
